event_structure.source: MainAnalysis.do lines 40-47 (Treatment3YrBefore..Treatment2YrAfter = 1{treatment_pair == 1 & tx_year - EventYear == -3..2}, Treatment3YrAfter = 1{tx_year - EventYear >= 3}) and line 242 (reg with all seven, TxYear* ODPair*, vce(cl OrgDestAirport)). Event time = tx_year - EventYear = rel = t - g with g = gyear (EventYear of treated pairs; years 2002-2017 consecutive). Omitted: rel <= -4 of treated pairs, pooled with the control pairs -> ref [null,-4]; every relative time is in a bin or the reference (nothing uncovered). EventYear is the true opening year of the first direct route (pairs with a direct flight before 2002 are excluded by construction, article Section 4), so the 2002 cohort adopts in the first sample year and no adoption_var is needed. Summaries: post = the three single years 0, 1, 2 (the open 3+ bin is reported but not averaged, endpoint convention); pre = rel -3, -2, -1 (all reported pre bins; the reference is rel <= -4).

Script ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2021.4103/nov2_verify_event_structure.R. replication_status: exact (authors' code output 0.070874 (0.0328222), N 9184, equals printed Table 3 column (1) post-bin average 0.071 (SE not printed), N 9,184, to the printed decimals; all seven printed bins match the code to 3 decimals; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
outcome_description: ln(1 + number of shared cadaveric kidneys)
notes: Origin-destination airport-pair x year panel 2002-2017, balanced. pair_id = integer code of OrgDestAirport (unit FE and cluster, as vce(cl OrgDestAirport)). gyear = EventYear for treated pairs (treatment_pair==1), NA for never-treated control pairs; D = 1[year >= gyear] equals the authors' TreatmentAfter on every row (checked). Treatment is absorbing (no switch-offs). The 2002 cohort is treated in the first panel year (always-treated): kept in TWFE/BJS samples as in the authors' regression; did::att_gt drops it. Authors' line 242: reg LnOrganVolume Treatment3YrBefore Treatment2YrBefore Treatment1YrBefore Treatment0YrAfter Treatment1YrAfter Treatment2YrAfter Treatment3YrAfter TxYear* ODPair* if airport_dist >= 800, vce(cl OrgDestAirport); single-year dummies for rel -3..2, a 3+ bin, and rel <= -4 omitted together with the control pairs. fixest reproduces all seven published coefficients and SEs to the third decimal (verify_T3_eventstudy.csv). Window chosen so that run_spec.R's bins (<=-4 bin, -3, -2, ref -1, 0, 1, 2, >=3 bin) partition relative time exactly as the authors do; only the omitted cell differs. Because the bins cover every treated row, their sum is the treated-pair indicator, which pair FE absorb, so the runner model is an exact reparametrization: each runner coefficient = authors' coefficient minus the rel -1 coefficient (0.0177; e.g. rel 0: 0.0890 - 0.0177 = 0.0713). Published-equivalent post average (rel 0..2, ref -1) = 0.0450967 (SE 0.0416623) raw = 0.18260 SD; pre average (rel -3, -2) = -0.0216388 (0.0481383) raw = -0.08761 SD. In the authors' own normalization the post average is 0.0628 (0.0361). The authors' headline 3+ bin (0.095) is the endpoint bin and is not part of the runner's post average. NOV 2 AUDIT: event_structure keeps the authors' bins and reference (ref = rel <= -4 pooled with control pairs; bins -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3+), replacing the rel = -1 re-normalization described above; the runner now estimates the authors' coefficients directly (post_summary rel 0..2 = 0.0627864 raw = 0.25422 SD with population SD 0.2469761; pre_summary rel -3..-1 = 0.0032638 raw = 0.01321 SD). No pre-sample adopters: the 2002 cohort opened its first direct route in 2002 (article Section 4 excludes pairs connected before 2002).
published_source: Printed Table 3, column (1) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2021.4103.pdf, p. 3669, main text), read Nov 4 2026; table number and values identical to the accepted manuscript in the package. published_coef = equal-weight mean of the printed post bins covered by event_structure.post_summary (year of treatment 0.089, 1 year after 0.050, 2 years after 0.050, 3 and more years after 0.095) = 0.071; no SE is printed for that average, so published_se is null (printed per-bin SEs in published_event_se); equals the authors' code output 0.070874 (delta-method SE 0.0328222) to the printed decimals, and each of the seven printed bins equals the code bin to 3 decimals. Earlier: Tr_Tx_final_main_body.pdf (accepted manuscript inside the package); authors' regression re-run in fixest on the shipped analysis .dta (Stata reg with ODPair*/TxYear* dummy sets = fixest pair + year FE with ssc(fixef.K='full')); Nov 2: checked against the typeset article (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2021.4103.txt, Table 3 col 1, p. 3669): identical to the manuscript values Nov 2 summary rule (team-lead: summaries average every reported bin, endpoint bins included): published_coef is now the equal-weight average of event years 0, 1, 2 and 3+ (all printed in Table 3 col 1) in the authors' normalization, 0.070874 (delta-method SE 0.032822, cluster pair, Stata dof); the previous value 0.0627864 is kept in published_coef_0_2. Pre-summary average 0.0032638.
